sloka: रामस्यारण्यगवनम् भरतस्यैव मातरम् ।धिगस्तु योषितो नाम शठाः स्वार्थपरास्सदा ॥२-१२-१०२॥
transliteration: rāmasyāraṇyagavanam bharatasyaiva mātaram ।dhigastu yoṣito nāma śaṭhāḥ svārthaparāssadā ॥2-12-102॥

translations.english: A woman means one who secretly harms others. This is shameful indeed. They always seek selfish interests. I do not say this of all women, only of Bharata's mother.
